name: button
title: Button
description: Primary action affordance. Renders a labeled, focusable, intent-bearing control. Five sizes × eight intents × three shapes. The single most important interaction component in Lumen. v0.12.2 dialed the primary-hover glow ladder down: rest unchanged at the brand-defining 0 0 16px lime-a25, hover trims to 0 0 20px lime-a28 plus quieter mid/outer halo layers (see ADR 0022).
